system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
| Issue | Seller’s position | What Buyer should want | Recommendation and reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001: General liability cap** | General Warranty Claims capped at 20% of price (AUD 4.8m). | 25% of price (AUD 6m). | **Reject; seek 25% (AUD 6m).** The 20% fallback requires Amelia Frost’s prior written approval identifying the draft; none is given. |
| **SPA-N-002: De minimis & basket** | AUD 25,000 de minimis; AUD 250,000 basket, with only the excess recoverable. | AUD 5,000 de minimis; AUD 50,000 aggregate basket, with recovery from the first dollar once exceeded. | **Reject; counter at playbook thresholds.** The Seller’s thresholds materially narrow recovery and its excess-only basket conflicts with the buyer’s first-dollar position. |
| **SPA-N-003: General claims time limit** | 18 months after Completion; Seller proposes limits apply to all Claims unless stated otherwise. | 24 months for general claims; keep other claim categories separate. | **Reject 18 months; require 24 months.** The 18-month fallback needs Amelia Frost’s written approval, which has not been given. |
| **SPA-N-004: Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title warranties subject to general caps and time limits. | Separate regime: 100% cap and at least six years, outside general basket, de minimis and knowledge bar. | **Reject; negotiate the separate regime.** Applying general limits would leave core ownership and capacity risks inadequately protected. |
| **SPA-N-005: Fraud carve-out** | Limitations, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance provisions apply to all Claims. | Fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct carved out of all caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance, to the maximum extent enforceable. | **Reject; require the carve-out.** The playbook prohibits waiving these protections. |
| **SPA-N-006: Disclosure scope** | General disclosure of the data room (including DD-002 to DD-012), Accounts, statutory registers and public records; specific disclosures do not limit it. | Specific fair disclosure; no deemed disclosure of the whole data room, public registers or prudent-search material. | **Reject general disclosure; require specific fair disclosure.** Broad deemed disclosure can defeat warranties without identifying the relevant facts fairly. |
| **SPA-N-007: Buyer knowledge qualifier** | No claim for matters known to Buyer or advisers, including matters discoverable in the data room or public records. | Delete blanket knowledge exclusions; if any qualifier remains, limit it to named Seller knowledge persons after reasonable enquiry, and never apply it to title, capacity, fraud or specific indemnities. | **Reject; remove the blanket exclusion.** Actual or constructive Buyer knowledge should not broadly erase the agreed protections. |
| **SPA-N-008: Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours; consent treated as satisfied on delivery of written consent. Disclosure says final consent and evidence of conditions being satisfied are absent. | Effective consent **and** evidence its conditions are satisfied before Completion; reasonable endeavours alone is insufficient for this material customer. | **Require the completed condition before Completion.** Bluefen represents about 30% of FY26 revenue, and consent on delivery alone does not establish its conditions are met. |
| **SPA-N-009: Riverlark facility** | Approximately AUD 3.2m facility to be addressed by a release following Completion; it remains unpaid and no final discharge is included. | Current payout; direct repayment from Completion funds; effective security releases. Any post-Completion release requires an irrevocable undertaking and Amelia Frost’s approval. | **Do not accept a bare post-Completion release.** Require repayment and effective releases at Completion, or the specified approved alternative. |
| **SPA-N-010: Employee bonuses** | AUD 420,000 closing bonuses are not separately itemised in the funds flow; on-costs are unstated. | Specific line item or Seller-funded amount, including triggered on-costs; funds flow must not silently exclude them. | **Require the funds flow to address the bonuses and on-costs.** The disclosed conditional liability is omitted from the draft funds flow. |
| **SPA-N-011: Ironquay IP indemnity** | Existing indemnity limited to the SOW3 payment; AUD 180,000 is open, not independently verified, and no payment receipt or confirmatory assignment is included. | Broaden the indemnity while preserving the SOW3 cure; do not treat AUD 180,000 as independently verified either way. | **Seek a broader indemnity with the cure preserved.** The narrow indemnity does not fully address the transfer risk, and the disclosed balance is unverified. |
| **SPA-N-012: Export/privacy incident** | Seller characterises DD-006 as preliminary and not expected to be material; records do not establish access, scope or notification duty and state no loss amount. | Preserve logs, investigate and provide updates; assume no confirmed breach, harm, notification duty or numeric demand in either direction. | **Require preservation, investigation and updates without asserting a confirmed breach or loss.** The disclosed facts leave key questions unresolved. |
| **SPA-N-013: Sandbar renewals** | Three related renewals total AUD 330,000; Seller calls them ordinary-course operating costs. | Assess timing, scope and whether they are unavoidable, terminable or accrued; no automatic Debt classification or price deduction. | **Assess under the agreed price mechanics; do not automatically deduct or classify as Debt.** The disclosures do not establish their treatment or whether the costs are unavoidable. |
| **SPA-N-014: Category separation** | Seller says tax and IP warranties are settled under the general regime, while limitations, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance provisions apply to all Claims. | Keep Title, Tax, IP, payment and covenant categories separate; no hidden general-regime override. Tax/IP remain open, with no assumed unlimited liability or resolution. | **Reject the blanket override and keep category terms open.** Seller’s proposed general regime would pre-empt unresolved category-specific negotiations. |
| **SPA-N-015: Title verification** | Seller relies on DD-012’s share register recording it as holder of 100% of issued shares. | Independent evidence of title, ownership, encumbrances and authority; DD-012 is an internal supplied source, not independent proof. | **Require independent verification.** The disclosed register identifies the source but does not itself establish independent title verification. |
| **SPA-N-016: Tax/IP open terms** | Seller considers tax and IP warranty positions settled under its general regime. | Keep Tax/IP terms open; do not assume unlimited liability or that the issues are resolved. | **Treat the terms as unresolved and negotiate them separately.** The playbook records no agreement on these terms. |
=== END ADVICE ===
